title: Patrice Fransez
summary: A custom Shopify theme built around the brand's identity, with flexible sections the team can rearrange without a developer.
overview: Patrice Fransez needed a storefront that looked and felt like the brand rather than a re-skinned template. I designed and developed the theme from the ground up, keeping the codebase small and the theme editor approachable for the people running the store day to day.
challenge: Off-the-shelf themes forced the catalogue into layouts that did not suit the products or the brand's tone, and every change meant asking a developer.
solution: I built a lightweight custom theme with reusable, block-based sections, so the team can compose and reorder pages directly in the theme editor. Typography, spacing and components follow one consistent system across every template.

title: Susanna Falken
summary: A refined redesign of an existing jewellery store, focused on clearer navigation and a calmer, more premium shopping experience.
overview: Susanna Falken already had a working jewellery store, but the design no longer matched where the brand was heading. The goal was a considered redesign, not a rebuild from zero: keep what worked, rework what did not.
challenge: Navigation and product pages had grown cluttered over time, which made browsing feel heavier than the products deserved.
solution: I simplified the information hierarchy, refined the typography and spacing, and reworked the collection and product templates so the imagery leads and the interface gets out of the way.

title: SR Beauty
summary: Speed and conversion improvements across the storefront, from image delivery to a smoother path from product to checkout.
overview: For the SR Beauty shop the brief was practical: make the store faster and make buying easier. I audited the existing theme, prioritised the changes with the best return, and shipped them in small, testable steps.
challenge: Heavy images and unnecessary scripts slowed pages down, and a few friction points on the product page made the path to purchase longer than it needed to be.
solution: I optimised image delivery, removed unused code, deferred non-critical scripts, and tightened the product page so price, variants and the add-to-cart action are clear at a glance on mobile.

title: ROMAAN
summary: A bespoke fragrance storefront with custom sections and a layout system designed to scale as the catalogue grows.
overview: ROMAAN, a fragrance brand, wanted a storefront with its own character and room to grow. I built a custom theme around a small set of well-designed sections that can be recombined as new collections and campaigns launch.
challenge: The brand needed distinctive layouts without the maintenance burden of one-off pages for every launch.
solution: I created a modular section library with sensible settings and presets, so new pages can be assembled quickly while staying visually consistent.

title: Risen
summary: Connecting a fragrance storefront with the tools the business relies on, while keeping the shopping experience fast.
overview: Risen Fragrances needed its store to work smoothly with the rest of its toolset. I handled the integration work and the front-end changes needed to surface it cleanly to customers.
challenge: Third-party tools can easily slow a storefront down or leave the experience feeling stitched together.
solution: I integrated the required services with care for performance, loading scripts only where they are needed and keeping the interface consistent with the rest of the theme.
